verseText: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
meaning: God loved the sinners of the world so much, he sent Jesus to rescue us from our sin.

recall.question: God loved the world so much that He gave us a wonderful gift. What was it?

meaning.question: Eternal life means living with God forever. How does this verse say we can receive eternal life?
choices: By reading our Bibles and praying

application.prompt: God loves us so much that He sent Jesus to save us from our sins! We don't have to earn His love by being good enough. When you mess up or wonder if God loves you, how can remembering what Jesus did for you help?
